text: Bug #1 (src/click/core.py, required flag): FIXED and verified. The implicit `self.default = False` for flags was applied even when the option was required, so a required flag could never be reported as missing. Changed `if is_flag and default_is_missing:` to `if is_flag and default_is_missing and not self.required:` (src/click/core.py:2519). Now `@click.option("--foo", is_flag=True, required=True)` invoked with no args exits 2 with "Error: Missing option '--foo'.", while `--foo` gives True, `default=False` still suppresses the error, and `--baz/--no-baz` required also errors when omitted. Full suite still green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Bug #4 (src/click/decorators.py, argument decorator cls): FIXED and verified. `argument()`'s decorator did `attrs.pop("cls", Argument)`, mutating the dict captured by the closure, so reusing the same decorator object (or applying it twice) silently dropped the custom `cls`. It now copies the attrs first (like `option()` does), so `cls` is preserved across repeated uses. Full suite still green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Bug #2 (echo with no streams, touches _compat.py/_termui_impl.py/utils.py): in progress. The plan is to make `_default_text_stdout`/`_default_text_stderr` return None when there is no stream, have `echo()` return early in that case, and guard the termui code that writes to those streams. ETA ~5 min.

Bug #3 (src/click/core.py, envvar flag value): in progress — probing the envvar/flag code paths (resolve_envvar_value, value_from_envvar, consume_value, get_default) to pin down the exact wrong line. ETA ~5 min.

Bug #5 (src/click/types.py, symlink resolution): in progress. `Path.convert` resolves a symlink by `os.readlink` + `os.path.realpath`, which is wrong for relative link targets (resolved against the CWD, not the link's directory) and for symlink chains; it should fully resolve the path (pathlib/os.path.realpath on the original path). ETA ~5 min.
Bug #6 (src/click/core.py, flag default_map): in progress — tracing `Context.lookup_default` / `Parameter.consume_value` / `Option.get_default` for flag options fed from `default_map`. ETA ~5 min.

Bug #5 (src/click/types.py, symlink resolution): FIXED and verified. `Path.convert` with `resolve_path=True` used `os.readlink` + `os.path.realpath`, which resolves a relative link target against the CWD (and doesn't handle symlink chains). It now resolves the original path with `pathlib.Path(...).resolve()` (keeping bytes in/bytes out and `path_type=` behaviour). Verified: relative symlink, absolute symlink and a link->link->file chain all return the real path; full suite still green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Bug #2 (echo with no streams): FIXED and verified. `_compat.py` now returns `None` from the cached `_default_text_stdout`/`_default_text_stderr`/`_default_text_stdin` helpers (and `_force_correct_text_stream`) when the underlying `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` is `None`; `utils.echo` returns early in that case instead of crashing with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'write'`; `_termui_impl.py`'s `ProgressBar` and `pager` fall back to a `StringIO` so they never see `None`. Verified `click.echo(...)`/`echo(err=True)`/`echo(b'...')` are silent no-ops with `sys.stdout = sys.stderr = None`, and the full suite is still green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).
Bug #3 (envvar flag value in core.py): still in progress — the envvar/flag code paths are being probed to pin down the mutated line; the fix has not landed yet. ETA ~3 min.

Bug #6 (flag default_map in core.py): still in progress — tracing `Context.lookup_default` / `Parameter.consume_value` / `Option.get_default` for flags fed from `default_map`; the fix has not landed yet. ETA ~3 min.
